prompt: A pavement closure blocks access to an assigned corner. Which plan follows the survey instructions?
promptZh: 人行道封閉，工作人員到不了指定街角。哪一種做法符合調查指示？

options.text: Call the coordinator first. If the coordinator approves another corner, note both sites before measuring.
options.zh: 先聯絡調查協調人員。若獲准換地點，應在量測前記下原地點和替代地點。
options.whyZh: 應先聯絡並取得同意，開始量測前要把兩個地點都寫在表單上。

options.text: Call first, but record only the new corner if the coordinator approves it.
options.zh: 先聯絡；如果獲准改用替代地點，就只記下新地點。
options.whyZh: 先聯絡正確，但獲准時須記下兩個地點，不能只記替代地點。

options.text: Start at another corner, note both sites, and call the coordinator after the survey.
options.zh: 先到另一個街角量測並記下兩個地點，調查結束後再聯絡。
options.whyZh: 兩個地點都應記下，但必須先聯絡並獲准，不能先量測。

options.text: Take the meter to the office and leave the location blank.
options.zh: 把音量計帶到辦公室，地點欄留白。
options.whyZh: 指定的替代程序是聯絡協調人員，在獲准後記下兩個地點。

evidence: If you can't reach your assigned corner because a pavement is closed, call me before choosing another place. If I approve a different corner, write both sites on the sheet before you start, so we can keep their readings separate.
explanationZh: 應先聯絡並取得同意，開始量測前要把兩個地點都寫在表單上。
difficultyRationale: Combine approval-before-moving and recording both locations before measurement; B/C satisfy different steps but not the sequence.

vocabulary.note: assigned 指事先分配給某人的地點；改點不是任意另找一處。
